title: Implicit-Reasoning-Enabled Elastic Semantic Communications for AI-Agent Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.20399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-agent networks introduce new communication demands driven by proactive interactions and autonomous task execution. Existing adaptive semantic communication schemes primarily adjust semantic representations and resource configurations within predefined processing scales and capability sets, which may be insufficient for evolving task requirements. To address this gap, we introduce elastic semantic communications (ESC), a task-driven framework that extends semantic adaptation to the runtime execution and participation of task-supporting capabilities. ESC comprises two complementary dimensions: vertical elasticity adjusts the execution intensity of existing capabilities, while horizontal elasticity reconfigures the participating capability set. The framework connects these dimensions through the expected marginal value of additional information and computation. To realize ESC, we propose an implicit-reasoning-enabled device--edge mecha

translated_title: 面向AI智能体网络的隐式推理使能弹性语义通信
translated_abstract: AI智能体网络因主动交互与自主任务执行而引入了新的通信需求。现有的自适应语义通信方案主要在预定义的处理规模和能力集合内调整语义表示与资源配置，这可能不足以满足不断演变的任务需求。为填补这一空白，我们提出了弹性语义通信（ESC），这是一个任务驱动的框架，将语义自适应扩展到支持任务的各项能力的运行时执行与参与。ESC包含两个互补的维度：垂直弹性调整现有能力的执行强度，而水平弹性则重新配置参与的能力集合。该框架通过额外信息与计算的期望边际价值将这两个维度联系起来。为实现ESC，我们提出了一种由隐式推理驱动的设备-边缘协同机制……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出弹性语义通信（ESC）这一任务驱动框架，通过垂直弹性（调整现有能力执行强度）与水平弹性（重构参与能力集合）两个互补维度，并借助隐式推理的设备-边缘协同机制加以实现，以满足AI智能体网络不断演变的任务与通信需求。
en_tdlr: We propose elastic semantic communications (ESC), a task-driven framework combining vertical elasticity (adjusting the execution intensity of existing capabilities) and horizontal elasticity (reconfiguring the participating capability set), realized via an implicit-reasoning-enabled device-edge mechanism to meet the evolving communication demands of AI-agent networks.
